snippet.title: "Twelve Sky2 World" new server is coming and will be launched in the second quarter of 2025
snippet.description:
BACN NETWORK TECHNOLOGY (HONG KONG) CO..LIMITED will enter the global market with the new MMORPG martial arts game "Twelve Sky2 World" based on the "Twelve Sky" IP, which is expected to be launched in Q2 2025.

"Twelve Sky World" is a large-scale 3D MMORPG online game classic version developed based on "Twelve Sky 2" and exclusively developed and operated by BACN NETWORK. In addition to continuing the complete game architecture of the previous game, it also has richer game content, exquisite art performance and fast-paced battle scenes, allowing players to truly experience the world's grievances and endless excitement.

"Twelve Sky World"will be a brand new 2.0 version. The official will work with players to create a 33-armor version with cool wings, powerful mounts, and cute pets, allowing you to fight with the martial arts heroes and experience the feeling of the game.

For more details, please visit the "Twelve Sky
2World" official Discord (discord.gg/DHwyNwuGEN).
